Tickets for Schools

Inspire your students with an unforgettable trip to Rose Theatre. Our exciting programme offers something for every age group, from family-friendly favourites and curriculum-linked productions to the enchantment of our much-loved annual Christmas show. Come and share the joy of live performance!

 

Ticket offers for schools

Groups of 10 or more enjoy generous discounts on selected shows, call the Box Office for the full details on 020 8174 0090.

Schools, colleges and universities can get tickets from £15 on selected performances for groups of 10 or more and an 11th teacher ticket is free for every 10 purchased.

 

How to book

Use our booking form below to request your tickets:

School booking form

If you need any assistance, our friendly box office team will be happy to help! You can contact us directly on roserequests@rosetheatre.org or 020 8174 0090.

Once your tickets have been booked, you will receive an invoice with the full details and a payment deadline. Any amends to your booking can be made before this date.

 

Rose Routes Scheme

Free Theatre Tickets & Workshops for Students! Do you work with young people who would benefit from theatre experiences or creative workshops, but face financial barriers? The Rose Routes Scheme is here to help. Find out more here.

 

FAQs

Is parking available?

There are coach drop off points opposite the theatre and plenty of car parks nearby. Please refer to our Getting Here page for more information about transport links and parking.

Can our students eat their packed lunch at the theatre?

Unfortunately, we don’t have a designated space for students to eat lunch at the theatre and we don’t allow food in the auditorium. We’re very lucky to be close to lots of lovely outdoor space, including the Kingston riverside. If it’s a sunny day, you will be able to find somewhere to eat with a great view!

Can we order ice-creams in advance?

Absolutely! Pre-order ice-cream here: Ice Cream Pre-Order Form

All ice-creams are gluten free and come in a range of flavours. Please place your order 7 working days before your visit.

What happens if we’re running late?

Please call our box office team on 020 8174 0090 to let them know. Each show is different, so admittance of latecomers is at the discretion of venue. We advise schools parties to aim to arrive 20 minutes before the start of the performance.

Do you offer accessible performances?

Relaxed, audio described and captioned performances are available for selected performances. Please contact the box office team to find out what’s available. You can find out more information about our access provision, including a visual story, here.

}

}
}

function (results, status) {

} else {

function loadTurnstileScript() {
var script = document.createElement('script');
script.src = 'https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/api.js?onload=onAyeCodeTurnstileLoad';
script.async = true;
document.head.appendChild(script);
}
window.onAyeCodeTurnstileLoad = function () {
window.ayecodeTurnstileLoaded = true;
// Render queued placeholders
window.ayecodeTurnstileQueue.forEach(function (placeholder) {
turnstile.render(placeholder, {
sitekey: placeholder.getAttribute('data-sitekey'),
theme: placeholder.getAttribute('data-theme'),
size: placeholder.getAttribute('data-size'),
});
});
window.ayecodeTurnstileQueue = [];
};
window.initializeTurnstilePlaceholders = function () { // Attach to window object
var placeholders = document.querySelectorAll('.ayecode-turnstile-placeholder:not([data-initialized])');
placeholders.forEach(function (placeholder) {
placeholder.setAttribute('data-initialized', 'true');
var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
if (entries[0].isIntersecting) {
observer.unobserve(placeholder);
if (window.ayecodeTurnstileLoaded) {
// Already loaded, render immediately
turnstile.render(placeholder, {
sitekey: placeholder.getAttribute('data-sitekey'),
theme: placeholder.getAttribute('data-theme'),
size: placeholder.getAttribute('data-size'),
});
} else {
// Not loaded yet, queue it
window.ayecodeTurnstileQueue.push(placeholder);
// Load the script if this is the first
if (window.ayecodeTurnstileQueue.length === 1) {
loadTurnstileScript();
}
}
}
}, {threshold: 0.1});
observer.observe(placeholder);
});
};
function resetAllTurnstiles() {
var placeholders = document.querySelectorAll('.ayecode-turnstile-placeholder[data-initialized]');
placeholders.forEach(function (placeholder) {
try {
// Attempt to reset the Turnstile widget
turnstile.reset(placeholder);
} catch (error) {
console.warn(`[Turnstile Reset Warning]: ${error.message}`);
}
});
}
// Listen for custom event to reset and reinitialize Turnstiles
document.addEventListener('ayecode_reset_captcha', function () {
resetAllTurnstiles();
initializeTurnstilePlaceholders();
});
// Initialize on page load
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', window.initializeTurnstilePlaceholders);
})();

placeholders.forEach(function (placeholder) {

var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {

observer.unobserve(placeholder);
if (window.ayecodeTurnstileLoaded) {

theme: placeholder.getAttribute('data-theme'),

});

}
}

observer.observe(placeholder);
});

<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2 data-pm-slice="1 1 []"><span><strong>Welcome to Southlands Arts Music</strong></span></h2>
<p><span>Southlands Arts has long been a cornerstone of creativity in our community, and it is best known for championing the visual arts. However, our musical arts program has flourished in recent years, offering a vibrant and growing space for musicians, performers, and music lovers alike.</span></p>
<h3><span><strong>Live Music & Events</strong></span></h3>
<p><span>Our annual </span><span><strong>Southlands Live</strong></span><span> festival has provided an incredible platform for emerging and established musicians to showcase their talents in a fun, community-driven setting. Each year, we celebrate live performances from diverse artists, fostering a unique festival atmosphere that brings people together through music.</span></p>
<p><span>In 2024, Southlands introduced a series of </span><span><strong>Revels Events</strong></span><span>—immersive gatherings filled with music, theatrical performances, and more. Our calendar featured spectacular occasions like the </span><span><strong>12th Night Revels</strong></span><span>, a Christmas-themed celebration, as well as </span><span><strong>Spring Revels</strong></span><span> and </span><span><strong>Piano, Poetry, and Prose</strong></span><span> nights, where music intertwined beautifully with storytelling and spoken word.</span></p>
<h3><span><strong>Music Classes & Workshops</strong></span></h3>
<p><span>We believe in nurturing musical talent and ensuring that everyone has access to learning opportunities. Currently, we are fortunate to host a talented violinist who offers violin lessons at Southlands. In the past, we have also provided </span><span><strong>piano lessons</strong></span><span> and other music workshops, and we look forward to expanding these offerings in the future.</span></p>
<h3><span><strong>A Home for All the Arts</strong></span></h3>
<p><span>At Southlands Arts, we are committed to fostering a creative hub that extends beyond visual arts. We embrace all forms of artistic expression, ensuring that music, performance, and creative collaboration have a welcoming home within our community. Whether you’re a musician, a music enthusiast, or simply looking for a space to enjoy live performances, Southlands Arts Music is here for you.</span></p>
<p><span><strong>Join Us!</strong></span><span> We invite you to be part of our growing musical community. Whether you want to attend an event, participate in a class, or even perform at one of our gatherings, there’s always a place for you at Southlands. Get in touch to learn more about upcoming events, lessons, and ways to get involved.</span></p>
<h3><span><strong>Stay Connected</strong></span></h3>
<p><span>Follow us for updates on upcoming events, new classes, and exciting collaborations!</span></p>
<p><span><em>Experience the harmony of creativity at Southlands Arts Music—where music meets community.</em></span></p></div>

return;

) {

function geodir_setsearch($form) {
if ((dist > 0 || (jQuery('select[name="sort_by"]', $form).val() == 'nearest' || jQuery('select[name="sort_by"]', $form).val() == 'farthest')) && (jQuery(".snear", $form).val() == '' || jQuery(".snear", $form).val() == 'Near')) jQuery(".snear", $form).val(default_location);
geocodeAddress($form);
}
function updateSearchPosition(latLng, $form) {
if (window.gdMaps === 'google') {
jQuery('.sgeo_lat').val(latLng.lat());
jQuery('.sgeo_lon').val(latLng.lng());
} else if (window.gdMaps === 'osm') {
jQuery('.sgeo_lat').val(latLng.lat);
jQuery('.sgeo_lon').val(latLng.lon);
}
jQuery($form).trigger("submit"); // submit form after inserting the lat long positions
}
function geocodeAddress($form) {
// Call the geocode function
Sgeocoder = window.gdMaps == 'google' ? new google.maps.Geocoder() : null;
if (jQuery('.snear', $form).val() == '' || ( jQuery('.sgeo_lat').val() != '' && jQuery('.sgeo_lon').val() != ''  ) || (jQuery('.snear', $form).val() && jQuery('.snear', $form).val().match("^In:"))) {
if (jQuery('.snear', $form).val() && jQuery('.snear', $form).val().match("^In:")) {
jQuery(".snear", $form).val('');
}
jQuery($form).trigger("submit");
} else {
var address = jQuery(".snear", $form).val();
if (address && address.trim() == 'Near') {
initialise2();
} else if(address && address.trim() == 'Near: My Location') {
jQuery($form).trigger("submit");
} else {
var search_address = address;
if (window.gdMaps === 'google') {
var geocodeQueryParams = {'address': search_address};
if (geodirIsZipCode(address)) {
if (typeof geocodeQueryParams['componentRestrictions'] != 'undefined') {
if (typeof geocodeQueryParams['componentRestrictions']['postalCode'] == 'undefined') {
geocodeQueryParams['componentRestrictions']['postalCode'] = address;
}
} else {
geocodeQueryParams['componentRestrictions'] = {'postalCode': address};
}
}
Sgeocoder.geocode(geocodeQueryParams,
function (results, status) {
if (status == google.maps.GeocoderStatus.OK) {
updateSearchPosition(results[0].geometry.location, $form);
} else {
alert("Search was not successful for the following reason :" + status);
}
});
} else if (window.gdMaps === 'osm') {
var osmCountryCodes = false;
geocodePositionOSM(false, search_address, osmCountryCodes, false,
function(geo) {
if (typeof geo !== 'undefined' && geo.lat && geo.lon) {
updateSearchPosition(geo, $form);
} else {
alert("Search was not successful for the requested address.");
}
});
} else {
jQuery($form).trigger("submit");
}
}
}
}
function geodirIsZipCode(string) {
if (/^\d+$/.test(string)) {
if (string.length > 3 && string.length < 7) {
return true;
}
}
return false;
}
function initialise2() {
if (!window.gdMaps) {
return;
}
if (window.gdMaps === 'google') {
var latlng = new google.maps.LatLng(56.494343, -4.205446);
var myOptions = {
zoom: 4,
mapTypeId: google.maps.MapTypeId.TERRAIN,
disableDefaultUI: true
}
} else if (window.gdMaps === 'osm') {
var latlng = new L.LatLng(56.494343, -4.205446);
var myOptions = {
zoom: 4,
mapTypeId: 'TERRAIN',
disableDefaultUI: true
}
}
try { prepareGeolocation(); } catch (e) {}
doGeolocation();
}
function doGeolocation() {
if (navigator.geolocation) {
navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(positionSuccess, positionError);
} else {
positionError(-1);
}
}
function positionError(err) {
var msg;
switch (err.code) {
case err.UNKNOWN_ERROR:
msg = "Unable to find your location";
break;
case err.PERMISSION_DENINED:
msg = "Permission denied in finding your location";
break;
case err.POSITION_UNAVAILABLE:
msg = "Your location is currently unknown";
break;
case err.BREAK:
msg = "Attempt to find location took too long";
break;
default:
msg = "Location detection not supported in browser";
}
jQuery('#info').html(msg);
}
function positionSuccess(position) {
var coords = position.coords || position.coordinate || position;
jQuery('.sgeo_lat').val(coords.latitude);
jQuery('.sgeo_lon').val(coords.longitude);
jQuery('.geodir-listing-search').trigger("submit");
}
/**
* On unload page do some cleaning so back button cache does not store these values.
*/
jQuery(window).on("beforeunload", function(e) {
if(jQuery('.sgeo_lat').length ){
jQuery('.sgeo_lat').val('');
jQuery('.sgeo_lon').val('');
}
});

(function () {

function loadTurnstileScript() {

script.src = 'https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/api.js?onload=onAyeCodeTurnstileLoad';
script.async = true;
document.head.appendChild(script);
}
window.onAyeCodeTurnstileLoad = function () {
window.ayecodeTurnstileLoaded = true;
// Render queued placeholders
window.ayecodeTurnstileQueue.forEach(function (placeholder) {
turnstile.render(placeholder, {
sitekey: placeholder.getAttribute('data-sitekey'),
theme: placeholder.getAttribute('data-theme'),
size: placeholder.getAttribute('data-size'),
});
});
window.ayecodeTurnstileQueue = [];
};
window.initializeTurnstilePlaceholders = function () { // Attach to window object
var placeholders = document.querySelectorAll('.ayecode-turnstile-placeholder:not([data-initialized])');
placeholders.forEach(function (placeholder) {
placeholder.setAttribute('data-initialized', 'true');
var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
if (entries[0].isIntersecting) {
observer.unobserve(placeholder);
if (window.ayecodeTurnstileLoaded) {
// Already loaded, render immediately
turnstile.render(placeholder, {
sitekey: placeholder.getAttribute('data-sitekey'),
theme: placeholder.getAttribute('data-theme'),
size: placeholder.getAttribute('data-size'),
});
} else {
// Not loaded yet, queue it
window.ayecodeTurnstileQueue.push(placeholder);
// Load the script if this is the first
if (window.ayecodeTurnstileQueue.length === 1) {
loadTurnstileScript();
}
}
}
}, {threshold: 0.1});
observer.observe(placeholder);
});
};
function resetAllTurnstiles() {
var placeholders = document.querySelectorAll('.ayecode-turnstile-placeholder[data-initialized]');
placeholders.forEach(function (placeholder) {
try {
// Attempt to reset the Turnstile widget
turnstile.reset(placeholder);
} catch (error) {
console.warn(`[Turnstile Reset Warning]: ${error.message}`);
}
});
}
// Listen for custom event to reset and reinitialize Turnstiles
document.addEventListener('ayecode_reset_captcha', function () {
resetAllTurnstiles();
initializeTurnstilePlaceholders();
});
// Initialize on page load
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', window.initializeTurnstilePlaceholders);
})();
</script>

}

});
function geodir_setsearch($form) {
if ((dist > 0 || (jQuery('select[name="sort_by"]', $form).val() == 'nearest' || jQuery('select[name="sort_by"]', $form).val() == 'farthest')) && (jQuery(".snear", $form).val() == '' || jQuery(".snear", $form).val() == 'Near')) jQuery(".snear", $form).val(default_location);
geocodeAddress($form);
}
function updateSearchPosition(latLng, $form) {
if (window.gdMaps === 'google') {
jQuery('.sgeo_lat').val(latLng.lat());
jQuery('.sgeo_lon').val(latLng.lng());
} else if (window.gdMaps === 'osm') {
jQuery('.sgeo_lat').val(latLng.lat);
jQuery('.sgeo_lon').val(latLng.lon);
}
jQuery($form).trigger("submit"); // submit form after inserting the lat long positions
}
function geocodeAddress($form) {
// Call the geocode function
Sgeocoder = window.gdMaps == 'google' ? new google.maps.Geocoder() : null;
if (jQuery('.snear', $form).val() == '' || ( jQuery('.sgeo_lat').val() != '' && jQuery('.sgeo_lon').val() != ''  ) || (jQuery('.snear', $form).val() && jQuery('.snear', $form).val().match("^In:"))) {
if (jQuery('.snear', $form).val() && jQuery('.snear', $form).val().match("^In:")) {
jQuery(".snear", $form).val('');
}
jQuery($form).trigger("submit");
} else {
var address = jQuery(".snear", $form).val();
if (address && address.trim() == 'Near') {
initialise2();
} else if(address && address.trim() == 'Near: My Location') {
jQuery($form).trigger("submit");
} else {
var search_address = address;
if (window.gdMaps === 'google') {
var geocodeQueryParams = {'address': search_address};
if (geodirIsZipCode(address)) {
if (typeof geocodeQueryParams['componentRestrictions'] != 'undefined') {
if (typeof geocodeQueryParams['componentRestrictions']['postalCode'] == 'undefined') {
geocodeQueryParams['componentRestrictions']['postalCode'] = address;
}
} else {
geocodeQueryParams['componentRestrictions'] = {'postalCode': address};
}
}
Sgeocoder.geocode(geocodeQueryParams,
function (results, status) {
if (status == google.maps.GeocoderStatus.OK) {
updateSearchPosition(results[0].geometry.location, $form);
} else {
alert("Search was not successful for the following reason :" + status);
}
});
} else if (window.gdMaps === 'osm') {
var osmCountryCodes = false;
geocodePositionOSM(false, search_address, osmCountryCodes, false,
function(geo) {
if (typeof geo !== 'undefined' && geo.lat && geo.lon) {
updateSearchPosition(geo, $form);
} else {
alert("Search was not successful for the requested address.");
}
});
} else {
jQuery($form).trigger("submit");
}
}
}
}
function geodirIsZipCode(string) {
if (/^\d+$/.test(string)) {
if (string.length > 3 && string.length < 7) {
return true;
}
}
return false;
}
function initialise2() {
if (!window.gdMaps) {
return;
}
if (window.gdMaps === 'google') {
var latlng = new google.maps.LatLng(56.494343, -4.205446);
var myOptions = {
zoom: 4,
mapTypeId: google.maps.MapTypeId.TERRAIN,
disableDefaultUI: true
}
} else if (window.gdMaps === 'osm') {
var latlng = new L.LatLng(56.494343, -4.205446);
var myOptions = {
zoom: 4,
mapTypeId: 'TERRAIN',
disableDefaultUI: true
}
}
try { prepareGeolocation(); } catch (e) {}
doGeolocation();
}
function doGeolocation() {
if (navigator.geolocation) {
navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(positionSuccess, positionError);
} else {
positionError(-1);
}
}
function positionError(err) {
var msg;
switch (err.code) {
case err.UNKNOWN_ERROR:
msg = "Unable to find your location";
break;
case err.PERMISSION_DENINED:
msg = "Permission denied in finding your location";
break;
case err.POSITION_UNAVAILABLE:
msg = "Your location is currently unknown";
break;
case err.BREAK:
msg = "Attempt to find location took too long";
break;
default:
msg = "Location detection not supported in browser";
}
jQuery('#info').html(msg);
}
function positionSuccess(position) {
var coords = position.coords || position.coordinate || position;
jQuery('.sgeo_lat').val(coords.latitude);
jQuery('.sgeo_lon').val(coords.longitude);
jQuery('.geodir-listing-search').trigger("submit");
}
/**
* On unload page do some cleaning so back button cache does not store these values.
*/
jQuery(window).on("beforeunload", function(e) {
if(jQuery('.sgeo_lat').length ){
jQuery('.sgeo_lat').val('');
jQuery('.sgeo_lon').val('');
}
});

(function () {
window.ayecodeTurnstileLoaded = false;

function loadTurnstileScript() {
var script = document.createElement('script');
script.src = 'https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/api.js?onload=onAyeCodeTurnstileLoad';
script.async = true;
document.head.appendChild(script);
}
window.onAyeCodeTurnstileLoad = function () {
window.ayecodeTurnstileLoaded = true;
// Render queued placeholders
window.ayecodeTurnstileQueue.forEach(function (placeholder) {
turnstile.render(placeholder, {
sitekey: placeholder.getAttribute('data-sitekey'),
theme: placeholder.getAttribute('data-theme'),
size: placeholder.getAttribute('data-size'),
});
});
window.ayecodeTurnstileQueue = [];
};
window.initializeTurnstilePlaceholders = function () { // Attach to window object
var placeholders = document.querySelectorAll('.ayecode-turnstile-placeholder:not([data-initialized])');
placeholders.forEach(function (placeholder) {
placeholder.setAttribute('data-initialized', 'true');
var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
if (entries[0].isIntersecting) {
observer.unobserve(placeholder);
if (window.ayecodeTurnstileLoaded) {
// Already loaded, render immediately
turnstile.render(placeholder, {
sitekey: placeholder.getAttribute('data-sitekey'),
theme: placeholder.getAttribute('data-theme'),
size: placeholder.getAttribute('data-size'),
});
} else {
// Not loaded yet, queue it
window.ayecodeTurnstileQueue.push(placeholder);
// Load the script if this is the first
if (window.ayecodeTurnstileQueue.length === 1) {
loadTurnstileScript();
}
}
}
}, {threshold: 0.1});
observer.observe(placeholder);
});
};
function resetAllTurnstiles() {
var placeholders = document.querySelectorAll('.ayecode-turnstile-placeholder[data-initialized]');
placeholders.forEach(function (placeholder) {
try {
// Attempt to reset the Turnstile widget
turnstile.reset(placeholder);
} catch (error) {
console.warn(`[Turnstile Reset Warning]: ${error.message}`);
}
});
}
// Listen for custom event to reset and reinitialize Turnstiles
document.addEventListener('ayecode_reset_captcha', function () {
resetAllTurnstiles();
initializeTurnstilePlaceholders();
});
// Initialize on page load
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', window.initializeTurnstilePlaceholders);
})();

function geocodeAddress($form) {

Sgeocoder = window.gdMaps == 'google' ? new google.maps.Geocoder() : null;

jQuery(".snear", $form).val('');

} else {

initialise2();
} else if(address && address.trim() == 'Near: My Location') {
jQuery($form).trigger("submit");
} else {
var search_address = address;
if (window.gdMaps === 'google') {

if (geodirIsZipCode(address)) {
if (typeof geocodeQueryParams['componentRestrictions'] != 'undefined') {
if (typeof geocodeQueryParams['componentRestrictions']['postalCode'] == 'undefined') {
geocodeQueryParams['componentRestrictions']['postalCode'] = address;
}
} else {
geocodeQueryParams['componentRestrictions'] = {'postalCode': address};
}
}
Sgeocoder.geocode(geocodeQueryParams,
function (results, status) {
if (status == google.maps.GeocoderStatus.OK) {
updateSearchPosition(results[0].geometry.location, $form);
} else {
alert("Search was not successful for the following reason :" + status);
}
});
} else if (window.gdMaps === 'osm') {
var osmCountryCodes = false;
geocodePositionOSM(false, search_address, osmCountryCodes, false,
function(geo) {
if (typeof geo !== 'undefined' && geo.lat && geo.lon) {
updateSearchPosition(geo, $form);
} else {
alert("Search was not successful for the requested address.");
}
});
} else {
jQuery($form).trigger("submit");
}
}
}
}
function geodirIsZipCode(string) {
if (/^\d+$/.test(string)) {
if (string.length > 3 && string.length < 7) {
return true;
}
}
return false;
}

function doGeolocation() {
if (navigator.geolocation) {

positionError(-1);

}
function positionError(err) {
var msg;
switch (err.code) {
case err.UNKNOWN_ERROR:

break;
case err.PERMISSION_DENINED:
msg = "Permission denied in finding your location";
break;
case err.POSITION_UNAVAILABLE:

break;
case err.BREAK:
msg = "Attempt to find location took too long";
break;
default:
msg = "Location detection not supported in browser";
}
jQuery('#info').html(msg);
}
function positionSuccess(position) {

(function () {
window.ayecodeTurnstileLoaded = false;
window.ayecodeTurnstileQueue = [];
function loadTurnstileScript() {
var script = document.createElement('script');
script.src = 'https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/api.js?onload=onAyeCodeTurnstileLoad';
script.async = true;
document.head.appendChild(script);
}
window.onAyeCodeTurnstileLoad = function () {
window.ayecodeTurnstileLoaded = true;
// Render queued placeholders
window.ayecodeTurnstileQueue.forEach(function (placeholder) {
turnstile.render(placeholder, {
sitekey: placeholder.getAttribute('data-sitekey'),
theme: placeholder.getAttribute('data-theme'),
size: placeholder.getAttribute('data-size'),
});
});
window.ayecodeTurnstileQueue = [];
};
window.initializeTurnstilePlaceholders = function () { // Attach to window object
var placeholders = document.querySelectorAll('.ayecode-turnstile-placeholder:not([data-initialized])');
placeholders.forEach(function (placeholder) {
placeholder.setAttribute('data-initialized', 'true');
var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
if (entries[0].isIntersecting) {
observer.unobserve(placeholder);
if (window.ayecodeTurnstileLoaded) {
// Already loaded, render immediately
turnstile.render(placeholder, {
sitekey: placeholder.getAttribute('data-sitekey'),
theme: placeholder.getAttribute('data-theme'),
size: placeholder.getAttribute('data-size'),
});
} else {
// Not loaded yet, queue it
window.ayecodeTurnstileQueue.push(placeholder);
// Load the script if this is the first
if (window.ayecodeTurnstileQueue.length === 1) {
loadTurnstileScript();
}
}
}
}, {threshold: 0.1});
observer.observe(placeholder);
});
};
function resetAllTurnstiles() {
var placeholders = document.querySelectorAll('.ayecode-turnstile-placeholder[data-initialized]');
placeholders.forEach(function (placeholder) {
try {
// Attempt to reset the Turnstile widget
turnstile.reset(placeholder);
} catch (error) {
console.warn(`[Turnstile Reset Warning]: ${error.message}`);
}
});
}
// Listen for custom event to reset and reinitialize Turnstiles
document.addEventListener('ayecode_reset_captcha', function () {
resetAllTurnstiles();
initializeTurnstilePlaceholders();
});
// Initialize on page load
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', window.initializeTurnstilePlaceholders);
})();

                    <p class="text-white">Akash has got 202,508 subscribers, a lizard best friend, and 47,492 followers to go before he loses everything. A story about the performance, identity, and everything real that gets lost off-camera. </p>

                                        <div class="mb-8">
                    <p class="text-white">The Flint Street Nativity is a warm, witty and joyful festive comedy packed with twisted Christmas carols, in which adults brilliantly recreate the triumphs, tantrums and tiny dramas of a group of seven-year-olds preparing their school nativity.</p>
                </div>
                                        <div class="mb-12">
                    <p class="text-white"><strong> Casting and setting</strong><br />
All roles are dual, with each performer playing first (and most importantly) a 7-8 year old child and in the final act, a parent. We are therefore looking for the ability to create distinct characters and an observance of the way children of that age group conduct themselves.<br />
<br />
Although the play text indicates that it could have its references updated and indeed be adapted to the area in which it is to be performed, so much of the character and charm of the writing of the piece comes from both a northern geography and an early 2000s setting, that the intention is to be as true to the original as possible, first staged in LIVERPOOL in 2006. For all roles except potentially Frankincense, we will therefore be seeking an appropriate regional accent. (But accent coaching can be provided!)<br />
<br />
Whilst being set and staged at Christmas, including music (carols essentially) and a great deal of humour, the play is not a pantomime and we are not seeking exaggerated or caricature performances. The writer states, <I>"Never has the word 'deadpan' been more apposite than when describing the comedy of children. They are never aware of their humour in this play. The less funny they find it, the funnier it will be."</I><br />
<br />
We are not looking for musical performers, but it is useful if most of the cast can carry a tune as they deliver important nuance and exposition via the contorted words to all the well-known Christmas carols.<br />
<br />
THIS PLAY IS <strong>FUN!</strong><br />
</p>
                </div>
                        <div class="flex flex-col mb-10 gap-y-4">
                                    <p class="text-white uppercase tag small"><span class="gradient-text">Director:</span> Guy Jones & Jason Salmon</p>
                                                    <p class="text-white uppercase tag small"><span class="gradient-text">Performances:</span> 9 - <span class="end-date">19 Dec 2026</span></p>
                                                                        <p class="text-white uppercase tag small"><span class="gradient-text">First Rehearsal:</span> 27 Sep 2026</p>
                            </div>
                            <div class="flex flex-col gap-y-6 mb-14">
                    <p class="uppercase tag small gradient-text">Characters:</p>
                                                                    <p class="text-white"><span class="font-semibold">Innkeeper - The Mischief-Maker:</span> MALE - Boldly confident, imaginative and socially dominant - The one that 'dares ya!' Doubles as Innkeeper's Dad, the local Mayor. (An avuncular pub landlord) Playing age: 20s-50</p>
                                                                    <p class="text-white"><span class="font-semibold">Mary - The Girly Swot:</span> FEMALE - A slave to every letter of the teacher's instructions, which can make her bossy, but she's well-intentioned and sweet. Doubles as Mary's Mum (An older version full of regretted compliance) Playing age: c.40</p>
                                                                    <p class="text-white"><span class="font-semibold">Wise Gold - The Bluffer:</span> FEMALE - Outwardly confident and comically certain; inwardly vulnerable, loyal and more compassionate than she initially appears. Doubles as Wise Gold's Mum (A self-absorbed, bingo-obsessed woman) Playing age: 20s-50</p>
                                                                    <p class="text-white"><span class="font-semibold">Shepherd - The Truth-Teller:</span> FEMALE - Grounded, observant and bluntly practical. She questions claims, spots inconsistencies and punctures pretension. Doubles as Shepherd's Mum (An older version keen to keep her husband grounded) Playing age: 20s-50</p>
                                                                    <p class="text-white"><span class="font-semibold">Gabriel - The Princess:</span> FEMALE - Socially powerful, watchful and ruthlessly controlling - the self-appointed enforcer of who is, and isn’t, speaking to whom. Doubles as Gabriel's Mum (An older version - bit of an insecure bitch) Playing age: 20s-30s</p>
                                                                    <p class="text-white"><span class="font-semibold">Star of Bethlehem - The Boffin:</span> MALE -  Intensely knowledgeable, literal and gloriously single-minded - he is the expert who will correct everyone, whether they asked or not. Doubles as Star's "Dad" (A fiercely enthusiastic wannabe parent)  Playing age: 20s-30s</p>
                                                                    <p class="text-white"><span class="font-semibold">Angel - The Follower:</span> FEMALE, SOUTH ASIAN - She takes her cues from stronger personalities, fears exclusion and prioritises belonging - even when resentment and hurt occasionally break through. Doubles as Angel's Mum (A more confident and together version, caught in an intense rivalry with an unseen Mrs Vorbani) Playing age: 20s-50</p>
                                                                    <p class="text-white"><span class="font-semibold">Narrator - The Perfectionist:</span> MALE - Earnest, conscientious and quietly anxious - desperate to get every word right and make a distant father proud. Doubles as Narrator's Dad  (Proud, but at a distance due to family tension) Playing age: 20s-50</p>
                                                                    <p class="text-white"><span class="font-semibold">Herod/Joseph - The Fantasist:</span> MALE - A sports-obsessed dreamer, heroically confident inside his private games but liable to crumble when faced with a real audience. Doubles as Herod's Dad (A somewhat detached workaholic) Playing age: 20s-50</p>
                                                                    <p class="text-white"><span class="font-semibold">Wise Frankincense - The Outsider:</span> MALE - A self-conscious newcomer, painfully aware of his speech impediment and determined to preserve his dignity while trying to find his place in the group. Playing age: 20s-50</p>
                                                                    <p class="text-white"><span class="font-semibold">Ass - The Innocent:</span> MALE - An uninhibited, socially unfiltered misfit who tries hard to join in, says whatever enters his head and remains remarkably cheerful despite being overlooked by the others. Playing age: 20s-50s</p>
                                    </div>
                                        <div class="mb-16">
                    <p class="text-white"><strong>Audition process</strong><br />
Auditions will be a fun and inclusive group exercise, with physical and vocal warm-ups and a singing element through which you will be guided. Please ensure you have at least familiarised yourself with the audition pieces available below for the role(s) in which you're interested. There is no requirement for any other preparation however - no lines need be learnt off book (unless you really want to impress!)<br />
<br />
Please note the LIVERPOOL regional accent and singing ideals stated above. Coaching will be available on the accents and a musical director has been appointed, but if accents and singing aren't your thing at all, please only consider Wise Frankincense. (Who will still have to sing)<br />
<br />
Successful auditionees may be invited to a <b>callback session on 13 September, 10:00 - 12:00.</b><br />
<br />
<strong>Availability</strong><br />
Please check your availability carefully before applying. All performers must be available for all scheduled rehearsals and performances, including rehearsals taking place within the "work Christmas do period."<br />
<br />
In particular, successful performers will need to be available:<br />
Up to and including 20 December (For the get-out)<br />
From 27 September onwards <br />
<br />
Rehearsals will be:<br />
Table-read Date TBC<br />
Sun 27 Sep - 10:00 - 12:30<br />
Mon 28 Sep - 20:00 - 22:00<br />
Sun 4 October - 16:45 - 20:15<br />
THEREAFTER:<br />
Wednesdays - 20:00 - 22:00<br />
Fridays - 20:00 - 22:00<br />
Sundays - 16:45 - 20:15<br />
<br />
Please only apply if you can commit to the full rehearsal and performance schedule with the most limited of exceptions. We will ask you to confirm your availability as part of the audition registration process.<br />
<br />
For more information and to register for a place at audition, <br><br />
<a href="https://calendly.com/stephen-southlondontheatre/auditions-flint-street"  target=_blank>GO TO THE REGISTRATION PAGE HERE</a> (opens in a new window).<br />
<br />
Please only email the director if the information you seek is not contained in the above.<br />
</p>
                </div>

                    <p class="text-white">Beth Steel's Till the Stars Come Down is set at a wedding in Nottingham and follows one family over a single, increasingly chaotic day. It is funny, affectionate and sharply observed, exploring family, class, love, loyalty, masculinity, changing communities and what happens when the past refuses to stay in the past.</p>
                </div>
                                        <div class="mb-12">
                    <p class="text-white"><strong> Casting and setting</strong><br />
Till the Stars Come Down is specifically rooted in Nottingham, and its characters belong to a traditional working-class family and community.<br />
<br />
The play's exploration of the decline and fragmentation of traditional working-class communities, including the legacy of the miners' strike, changing employment, generational differences and questions of belonging is central to the story. We therefore want the casting to authentically reflect the social and cultural world Beth Steel has created.<br />
<br />
This is not intended as a blanket exclusion of performers; rather, for these particular family roles, authentic representation of the world of the play is an important part of our casting process.<br />
<br />
We particularly welcome actors who have a genuine connection to the area in which it is set or similar working-class communities and who understand the humour, rhythms and lived experience that underpin the play. For the role of Marek, we would like to cast someone who is Polish or of Polish heritage. </p>
                </div>
                        <div class="flex flex-col mb-10 gap-y-4">
                                    <p class="text-white uppercase tag small"><span class="gradient-text">Director:</span> Charlotte Benstead</p>
                                                    <p class="text-white uppercase tag small"><span class="gradient-text">Performances:</span> 11 - <span class="end-date">16 Jan 2027</span></p>
                                                                        <p class="text-white uppercase tag small"><span class="gradient-text">First Rehearsal:</span> 18 Oct 2026</p>
                            </div>
                            <div class="flex flex-col gap-y-6 mb-14">
                    <p class="uppercase tag small gradient-text">Characters:</p>
                                                                    <p class="text-white"><span class="font-semibold">Hazel:</span> Female - Playing age: late 30s–40s - The eldest of the three sisters and the person who keeps the family machinery running. Hazel is practical, capable and fiercely loyal, but she is also exhausted from carrying everyone else's problems. She has a sharp sense of humour and a strong moral compass, although the pressures of family life have left her with plenty of frustrations of her own.</p>
                                                                    <p class="text-white"><span class="font-semibold">Maggie:</span> Female - Playing age: 35–45 - Maggie is the middle sister. Maggie is warm, funny, impulsive and capable of causing absolute havoc without necessarily intending to. She is someone who wants more from life and isn't always very good at thinking through the consequences of getting it.</p>
                                                                    <p class="text-white"><span class="font-semibold">Sylvia:</span> Female - Playing age: 25–30 - The youngest of the three sisters and the bride at the centre of the day's celebrations. Sylvia is excited, romantic and determined to enjoy her wedding, but beneath the celebration she is navigating the complicated dynamics of her family.</p>
                                                                    <p class="text-white"><span class="font-semibold">John:</span> Male - Playing age: 40s - Hazel's husband. John is currently out of work and is struggling with his sense of purpose and place within the family. He is not a stereotypical villain: he is funny, complicated, vulnerable and capable of making very poor decisions.</p>
                                                                    <p class="text-white"><span class="font-semibold">Tony:</span> Male - Playing age: Late 60s-70s - Sylvia, Hazel and Maggie's father. Widowed, Tony is the older generation at the heart of the family and has lived through a very different Nottingham. He carries the history of the family and of the community in which his daughters grew up.</p>
                                                                    <p class="text-white"><span class="font-semibold">Peter:</span> Male - Playing age: mid 60s-70 - Tony's brother and Sylvia, Hazel and Maggie's uncle. Peter is married to Aunty Carol. He and Tony have been estranged since the miners' strike in the 1980s, leaving decades of resentment and unfinished business between the brothers.</p>
                                                                    <p class="text-white"><span class="font-semibold">Aunty Carol:</span> Female - Playing age: 60–70 - Peter's wife and an important part of the wider family. Carol is warm, practical and perceptive, with a good instinct for what is really going on beneath the surface.</p>
                                                                    <p class="text-white"><span class="font-semibold">Marek:</span> Male - Playing age: 30–40 - Sylvia's fiancé. Marek is Polish and has made a life for himself in Nottingham. He is loving, hardworking and committed to Sylvia, but is entering a family whose history, arguments and loyalties are far more complicated than he could have anticipated.</p>
                                                                    <p class="text-white"><span class="font-semibold">Leanne:</span> Female - Playing age: 15–18 - Hazel and John's daughter. Leanne is a teenager with a sharp eye for the adults around her. She is funny, observant and increasingly aware that the grown-ups' lives are considerably more complicated than they would like their children to believe.</p>
                                                                    <p class="text-white"><span class="font-semibold">Sarah:</span> Female - Playing age: 8–11 - This role will be cast from our existing Youth Group membership. No external applicants will be considered.</p>
                                    </div>
                                        <div class="mb-16">
                    <p class="text-white"><strong>Audition process</strong><br />
Because Till the Stars Come Down is rooted so strongly in North Notts/South Yorks, authentic and convincing regional accents are an important part of our production.<br />
<br />
First Stage – We will be booking 10-minute slots for each auditionee between 6.30pm-9.15pm on 19th September or 10am-12.15pm on Sunday 20th September. <br />
<br />
Please prepare one of the 4 speeches using the link below. <br />
<br />
At this stage we will also consider whether your playing age is appropriate for the role you are interested in. Selected performers will be invited to an in-person audition that will take place on Sunday 27th September from 10am. <br />
<br />
We appreciate that accents can be developed and coached, but performers should be able to demonstrate a convincing starting point at the initial audition. Authenticity, naturalism and consistency are particularly important for this production.<br />
<br />
<strong.Availability</strong><br />
Please check your availability carefully before applying. All performers must be available for all scheduled rehearsals and performances, including rehearsals taking place around the Christmas period.<br />
In particular, successful performers will need to be available:<br />
Up to and including 20 December <br />
From 3 January onwards <br />
<br />
There will be a break over Christmas and New Year, but the production will require performers to return promptly for rehearsals from 3 January. Please only apply if you can commit to the full rehearsal and performance schedule. We will ask you to confirm your availability as part of the audition process.<br />
<br />
Our rehearsal schedule is 8pm Tuesday/Thursdays and Sundays at 1pm<br />
<br />
Rehearsals will commence on 18th October with a readthrough the week before to be determined.<br />
<br />
For more information, detailed character breakdowns, and to register for a place at audition, <br><br />
<a href="https://calendly.com/stephen-southlondontheatre/auditions-til-the-stars-come-down?back=1&month=2026-09"  target=_blank>GO TO THE REGISTRATION PAGE HERE</a> (opens in a new window).<br />
<br />
Please only email the director if the information you seek is not contained in the above.<br />
</p>

/*# sourceURL=global-styles-inline-css */</style><style id="admin-bar-inline-css">/* Hide CanvasJS credits for P404 charts specifically */
    #p404RedirectChart .canvasjs-chart-credit {
        display: none !important;
    }
    
    #p404RedirectChart canvas {
        border-radius: 6px;
    }

    .p404-redirect-adminbar-weekly-title {
        font-weight: bold;
        font-size: 14px;
        color: #fff;
        margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button .ab-icon:before {
        content: "\f103";
        color: #dc3545;
        top: 3px;
    }
    
    #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button .ab-item {
        min-width: 80px !important;
        padding: 0px !important;
    }
    
    /* Ensure proper positioning and z-index for P404 dropdown */
    .p404-redirect-adminbar-dropdown-wrap { 
        min-width: 0; 
        padding: 0;
        position: static !important;
    }
    
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button_dropdown {
        position: static !important;
    }
    
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button_dropdown .ab-item {
        padding: 0 !important;
        margin: 0 !important;
    }
    
    .p404-redirect-dropdown-container {
        min-width: 340px;
        padding: 18px 18px 12px 18px;
        background: #23282d !important;
        color: #fff;
        border-radius: 12px;
        box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
        margin-top: 10px;
        position: relative !important;
        z-index: 999999 !important;
        display: block !important;
        border: 1px solid #444;
    }
    
    /* Ensure P404 dropdown appears on hover */
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button .p404-redirect-dropdown-container { 
        display: none !important;
    }
    
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button:hover .p404-redirect-dropdown-container { 
        display: block !important;
    }
    
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button:hover #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button_dropdown .p404-redirect-dropdown-container {
        display: block !important;
    }
    
    .p404-redirect-card {
        background: #2c3338;
        border-radius: 8px;
        padding: 18px 18px 12px 18px;
        box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.07);
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: flex-start;
        border: 1px solid #444;
    }
    
    .p404-redirect-btn {
        display: inline-block;
        background: #dc3545;
        color: #fff !important;
        font-weight: bold;
        padding: 5px 22px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        text-decoration: none;
        font-size: 17px;
        transition: background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
        margin-top: 8px;
        box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(220,53,69,0.15);
        text-align: center;
        line-height: 1.6;
    }
    
    .p404-redirect-btn:hover {
        background: #c82333;
        color: #fff !important;
        box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(220,53,69,0.25);
    }
    
    /* Prevent conflicts with other admin bar dropdowns */
    #wpadminbar .ab-top-menu > li:hover > .ab-item,
    #wpadminbar .ab-top-menu > li.hover > .ab-item {
        z-index: auto;
    }
    
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button:hover > .ab-item {
        z-index: 999998 !important;
    }

directing, acting, movement and design.<br><br>Coming up are:</p></div></div><div style="height:22px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div><div style="height:2px;margin: 0 0 10px style="flex-basis:80%"><p class="has-text-align-center"><em>Saturday 5 September at 10am</em><br><strong>Workshop: Clowning Techniques for Actors</strong></p><p>What can clowning techniques bring to our acting toolbox?<br><br>
Julie Joubert’s workshop will introduce you to clowning principles. With a series of games based on physical improvisation, we will explore how the clown’s raw authenticity can help us play characters and dynamics that feel genuine to the audience, across comedy and drama.</p></div></div><div style="background-color: #bc0b07;border: none;width:100%;margin:auto;color: white;padding: 15px 32px;text-align: center;text-decoration: none;border-radius:13px"> <a style="color:#ffffff" href="https://www.towertheatre.org.uk/event/clowning/"><b>More information and sign up here to attend</b></a></div><div style="height:19px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div><div style="height:2px;margin: 0 0 10px 0;background-color:#bc0b07"> </div><div class="wp-block-columns"><div class="wp-block-column" style="flex-basis:20%"><figure class="wp-block-image size-full"><img decoding="async" src="https://www.towertheatre.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Autumn-Poetry-Evening.png" width="200px" alt="Poetry Evening" style="padding-right:16px"></figure></div><div class="wp-block-column" style="flex-basis:80%"><p class="has-text-align-center"><em>Sunday 27  September at 7pm in the Smith Studio</em><br><strong>Autumn Poetry Evening</strong></p><p>We’re pleased to announce that we’ll be gathering together for our twice-yearly celebration of poetry old and new.<br><br>
Curated once again by George Savona, the evening brings members together to enjoy and share poetry in a relaxed, welcoming setting. Participants are invited to read a favourite poem – whether a much-loved classic, a hidden gem, or even a piece of their own writing. Come along to read a poem or relax and enjoy the culture with a glass of something (the bar will be open).<br><br>Free to Members, Friends and guests!<br><br>If you’d like to perform on the night, please contact <a href="/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#3057555f4257551e4351465f5e51705244595e4455425e55441e535f5d"><b>George Savona</b></a> by Sunday 20 September with your suggestions for pieces you’d /*# sourceURL=global-styles-inline-css */</style><style id="admin-bar-inline-css">/* Hide CanvasJS credits for P404 charts specifically */
    #p404RedirectChart .canvasjs-chart-credit {
        display: none !important;
    }
    
    #p404RedirectChart canvas {
        border-radius: 6px;
    }

    .p404-redirect-adminbar-weekly-title {
        font-weight: bold;
        font-size: 14px;
        color: #fff;
        margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button .ab-icon:before {
        content: "\f103";
        color: #dc3545;
        top: 3px;
    }
    
    #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button .ab-item {
        min-width: 80px !important;
        padding: 0px !important;
    }
    
    /* Ensure proper positioning and z-index for P404 dropdown */
    .p404-redirect-adminbar-dropdown-wrap { 
        min-width: 0; 
        padding: 0;
        position: static !important;
    }
    
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button_dropdown {
        position: static !important;
    }
    
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button_dropdown .ab-item {
        padding: 0 !important;
        margin: 0 !important;
    }
    
    .p404-redirect-dropdown-container {
        min-width: 340px;
        padding: 18px 18px 12px 18px;
        background: #23282d !important;
        color: #fff;
        border-radius: 12px;
        box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
        margin-top: 10px;
        position: relative !important;
        z-index: 999999 !important;
        display: block !important;
        border: 1px solid #444;
    }
    
    /* Ensure P404 dropdown appears on hover */
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button .p404-redirect-dropdown-container { 
        display: none !important;
    }
    
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button:hover .p404-redirect-dropdown-container { 
        display: block !important;
    }
    
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button:hover #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button_dropdown .p404-redirect-dropdown-container {
        display: block !important;
    }
    
    .p404-redirect-card {
        background: #2c3338;
        border-radius: 8px;
        padding: 18px 18px 12px 18px;
        box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.07);
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: flex-start;
        border: 1px solid #444;
    }
    
    .p404-redirect-btn {
        display: inline-block;
        background: #dc3545;
        color: #fff !important;
        font-weight: bold;
        padding: 5px 22px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        text-decoration: none;
        font-size: 17px;
        transition: background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
        margin-top: 8px;
        box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(220,53,69,0.15);
        text-align: center;
        line-height: 1.6;
    }
    
    .p404-redirect-btn:hover {
        background: #c82333;
        color: #fff !important;
        box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(220,53,69,0.25);
    }
    
    /* Prevent conflicts with other admin bar dropdowns */
    #wpadminbar .ab-top-menu > li:hover > .ab-item,
    #wpadminbar .ab-top-menu > li.hover > .ab-item {
        z-index: auto;
    }
    
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button:hover > .ab-item {
        z-index: 999998 !important;
    }

/*# sourceURL=global-styles-inline-css */</style><style id="admin-bar-inline-css">/* Hide CanvasJS credits for P404 charts specifically */
    #p404RedirectChart .canvasjs-chart-credit {
        display: none !important;
    }
    
    #p404RedirectChart canvas {
        border-radius: 6px;
    }

    .p404-redirect-adminbar-weekly-title {
        font-weight: bold;
        font-size: 14px;
        color: #fff;
        margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button .ab-icon:before {
        content: "\f103";
        color: #dc3545;
        top: 3px;
    }
    
    #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button .ab-item {
        min-width: 80px !important;
        padding: 0px !important;
    }
    
    /* Ensure proper positioning and z-index for P404 dropdown */
    .p404-redirect-adminbar-dropdown-wrap { 
        min-width: 0; 
        padding: 0;
        position: static !important;
    }
    
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button_dropdown {
        position: static !important;
    }
    
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button_dropdown .ab-item {
        padding: 0 !important;
        margin: 0 !important;
    }
    
    .p404-redirect-dropdown-container {
        min-width: 340px;
        padding: 18px 18px 12px 18px;
        background: #23282d !important;
        color: #fff;
        border-radius: 12px;
        box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
        margin-top: 10px;
        position: relative !important;
        z-index: 999999 !important;
        display: block !important;
        border: 1px solid #444;
    }
    
    /* Ensure P404 dropdown appears on hover */
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button .p404-redirect-dropdown-container { 
        display: none !important;
    }
    
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button:hover .p404-redirect-dropdown-container { 
        display: block !important;
    }
    
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button:hover #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button_dropdown .p404-redirect-dropdown-container {
        display: block !important;
    }
    
    .p404-redirect-card {
        background: #2c3338;
        border-radius: 8px;
        padding: 18px 18px 12px 18px;
        box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.07);
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: flex-start;
        border: 1px solid #444;
    }
    
    .p404-redirect-btn {
        display: inline-block;
        background: #dc3545;
        color: #fff !important;
        font-weight: bold;
        padding: 5px 22px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        text-decoration: none;
        font-size: 17px;
        transition: background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
        margin-top: 8px;
        box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(220,53,69,0.15);
        text-align: center;
        line-height: 1.6;
    }
    
    .p404-redirect-btn:hover {
        background: #c82333;
        color: #fff !important;
        box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(220,53,69,0.25);
    }
    
    /* Prevent conflicts with other admin bar dropdowns */
    #wpadminbar .ab-top-menu > li:hover > .ab-item,
    #wpadminbar .ab-top-menu > li.hover > .ab-item {
        z-index: auto;
    }
    
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button:hover > .ab-item {
        z-index: 999998 !important;
    }

and the community. </p><p class="wp-block-paragraph">These events include rehearsed readings, informal social gatherings, Q&A sessions with playwrights and experts, quiz nights as well as workshops on directing, acting, movement and design.<br><br>Coming up are:</p></div></div><div style="height:22px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div><div style="height:2px;margin: 0 0 10px style="flex-basis:80%"><p class="has-text-align-center"><em>Saturday 5 September at 10am</em><br><strong>Workshop: Clowning Techniques for Actors</strong></p><p>What can clowning techniques bring to our acting toolbox?<br><br>
Julie Joubert’s workshop will introduce you to clowning principles. With a series of games based on physical improvisation, we will explore how the clown’s raw authenticity can help us play characters and dynamics that feel genuine to the audience, across comedy and drama.</p></div></div><div style="background-color: #bc0b07;border: none;width:100%;margin:auto;color: white;padding: 15px 32px;text-align: center;text-decoration: none;border-radius:13px"> <a style="color:#ffffff" href="https://www.towertheatre.org.uk/event/clowning/"><b>More information and sign up here to attend</b></a></div><div style="height:19px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div><div style="height:2px;margin: 0 0 10px 0;background-color:#bc0b07"> </div><div class="wp-block-columns"><div class="wp-block-column" style="flex-basis:20%"><figure class="wp-block-image size-full"><img decoding="async" src="https://www.towertheatre.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Autumn-Poetry-Evening.png" width="200px" alt="Poetry Evening" style="padding-right:16px"></figure></div><div class="wp-block-column" style="flex-basis:80%"><p class="has-text-align-center"><em>Sunday 27  September at 7pm in the Smith Studio</em><br><strong>Autumn Poetry Evening</strong></p><p>We’re pleased to announce that we’ll be gathering together for our twice-yearly celebration of poetry old and new.<br><br>
Curated once again by George Savona, the evening brings members together to enjoy and share poetry in a relaxed, welcoming setting. Participants are invited to read a favourite poem – whether a much-loved classic, a hidden gem, or even a piece of their own writing. Come along to read a poem or relax and enjoy the culture with a glass of something (the bar will be open).<br><br>Free to Members, Friends and guests!<br><br>If you’d like to perform on the night, please contact <a href="/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#0265676d7065672c7163746d6c634260766b6c7667706c67762c616d6f"><b>George Savona</b></a> by Sunday 20 September with your suggestions for pieces you’d like to read.</p></div></div><div style="height:19px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div><div style="height:2px;margin: 0 0 10px 0;background-color:#bc0b07"> </div><div /*# sourceURL=global-styles-inline-css */</style><style id="admin-bar-inline-css">/* Hide CanvasJS credits for P404 charts specifically */
    #p404RedirectChart .canvasjs-chart-credit {
        display: none !important;
    }
    
    #p404RedirectChart canvas {
        border-radius: 6px;
    }

    .p404-redirect-adminbar-weekly-title {
        font-weight: bold;
        font-size: 14px;
        color: #fff;
        margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button .ab-icon:before {
        content: "\f103";
        color: #dc3545;
        top: 3px;
    }
    
    #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button .ab-item {
        min-width: 80px !important;
        padding: 0px !important;
    }
    
    /* Ensure proper positioning and z-index for P404 dropdown */
    .p404-redirect-adminbar-dropdown-wrap { 
        min-width: 0; 
        padding: 0;
        position: static !important;
    }
    
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button_dropdown {
        position: static !important;
    }
    
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button_dropdown .ab-item {
        padding: 0 !important;
        margin: 0 !important;
    }
    
    .p404-redirect-dropdown-container {
        min-width: 340px;
        padding: 18px 18px 12px 18px;
        background: #23282d !important;
        color: #fff;
        border-radius: 12px;
        box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
        margin-top: 10px;
        position: relative !important;
        z-index: 999999 !important;
        display: block !important;
        border: 1px solid #444;
    }
    
    /* Ensure P404 dropdown appears on hover */
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button .p404-redirect-dropdown-container { 
        display: none !important;
    }
    
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button:hover .p404-redirect-dropdown-container { 
        display: block !important;
    }
    
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button:hover #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button_dropdown .p404-redirect-dropdown-container {
        display: block !important;
    }
    
    .p404-redirect-card {
        background: #2c3338;
        border-radius: 8px;
        padding: 18px 18px 12px 18px;
        box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.07);
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: flex-start;
        border: 1px solid #444;
    }
    
    .p404-redirect-btn {
        display: inline-block;
        background: #dc3545;
        color: #fff !important;
        font-weight: bold;
        padding: 5px 22px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        text-decoration: none;
        font-size: 17px;
        transition: background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
        margin-top: 8px;
        box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(220,53,69,0.15);
        text-align: center;
        line-height: 1.6;
    }
    
    .p404-redirect-btn:hover {
        background: #c82333;
        color: #fff !important;
        box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(220,53,69,0.25);
    }
    
    /* Prevent conflicts with other admin bar dropdowns */
    #wpadminbar .ab-top-menu > li:hover > .ab-item,
    #wpadminbar .ab-top-menu > li.hover > .ab-item {
        z-index: auto;
    }
    
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button:hover > .ab-item {
        z-index: 999998 !important;
    }

Other companies performing at the Tower Theatre may offer tickets at different prices.</p><p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Advance – Online and Phone Bookings</strong></p><ul class="wp-block-list"><li>Adult (General Admission) – £16</li><li>Concession* – £14</li><li>Friend or Member – £12.50</li><li>Children under 18 – £10</li></ul><p class="wp-block-paragraph">Online booking is available at any time up until the start of the performance.</p><p class="wp-block-paragraph">Booking by phone is available on weekdays between 10am and 6pm at 020 7353 1700.</p><p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Box Office – At the Performance</strong></p><ul class="wp-block-list"><li>Adult (General Admission) – £18</li><li>Concession* – £16</li><li>Friend or Member – £14.50</li><li>Children under 18 – £12</li></ul><p class="wp-block-paragraph">*Concession ticket prices are available for for senior citizens, unemployed and registered disabled.</p><p><strong><font color="#bc0b07">First Night Preview – all tickets HALF PRICE!</font><br />Each type of ticket is available at half the normal price for the first performance of each Tower Theatre show.</strong></p><p class="wp-block-paragraph">Discounts are available for groups of 10+ tickets and school parties if booked in one order.  Please contact our office by <a href="/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#c7aea9a1a887b3a8b0a2b5b3afa2a6b3b5a2e9a8b5a0e9b2ac" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener nofollow"><b><font color="#bc0b07">email </font></b></a> or telephone (Box Office : 020 7353 1700) to receive the discounted bulk price.</p><p class="wp-block-paragraph">If you are a wheelchair user, please book via telephone (020 7353 1700) or <a href="/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#bfd6d1d9d0ffcbd0c8dacdcbd7dadecbcdda91d0cdd891cad4" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener nofollow"><b><font color="#bc0b07">email the office</font></b></a> at least one week in advance if you want to book a wheelchair place so that we can make appropriate arrangements to accommodate you. One carer per wheelchair user may attend at no cost if booked at the same time.</p><h2 class="wp-block-heading">Terms and Conditions</h2><p class="wp-block-paragraph"></p><p class="wp-block-paragraph">When you make a booking your order will be confirmed by email. Please bring this email (either on your phone or printed out) when you attend the performance.<br><br>We will refund tickets only in the event of cancellation of a performance. However, tickets may be exchanged for tickets to alternative performances of the same production if you notify us in advance by email on Monday – Friday before 6pm, subject to availability. This excludes tickets to discounted preview performances.</p><p class="wp-block-paragraph">If you notify us in time we may be able to resell unwanted tickets on the day of the performance on your behalf once we have sold all our own tickets. Even for popular shows, we cannot guarantee resale. If we are able to sell them, we will refund you (minus an administration charge). We can also transfer tickets to a friend or relative if you can find someone else to use them.<br><br>Seats are unreserved.<br><br>Latecomers may be asked to wait for a break in the production before taking their seats.</p><div class="wp-block-image"><figure class="aligncenter"><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" width="1024" height="819" src="https://www.towertheatre.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/2019/08/TowerTheatre-AK-1070-1024x819.jpg" alt="" class="wp-image-2767" srcset="https://www.towertheatre.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/2019/08/TowerTheatre-AK-1070-1024x819.jpg 1024w, https://www.towertheatre.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/2019/08/TowerTheatre-AK-1070-scaled-800x639.jpg 800w, https://www.towertheatre.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/2019/08/TowerTheatre-AK-1070-300x240.jpg 300w, https://www.towertheatre.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/2019/08/TowerTheatre-AK-1070-768x614.jpg 768w, https://www.towertheatre.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/2019/08/TowerTheatre-AK-1070-scaled-1240x991.jpg 1240w, https://www.towertheatre.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/2019/08/TowerTheatre-AK-1070-scaled.jpg 2048w" sizes="(max-width: 1024px) 100vw, 1024px" /></figure></div></div><footer class="entry-footer"><div id="comments" class="comments-area"></div></footer></main></div></div></div></div><footer><div class="bootscore-footer bg-body-tertiary pt-5 pb-3"><div class="container"><div class="row"><div class="col-md-6 col-lg-3"><div class="footer_widget mb-4"><p class="zoom-social-icons-list--align-center"><a href="https://www.towertheatre.org.uk/contact-us/"><b>Contact Us</b></a> </p><ul class="zoom-social-icons-list zoom-social-icons-list--with-canvas zoom-social-icons-list--round zoom-social-icons-list--align-center zoom-social-icons-list--no-labels"><li class="zoom-social_icons-list__item">

/*# sourceURL=global-styles-inline-css */</style><style id="admin-bar-inline-css">/* Hide CanvasJS credits for P404 charts specifically */
    #p404RedirectChart .canvasjs-chart-credit {
        display: none !important;
    }
    
    #p404RedirectChart canvas {
        border-radius: 6px;
    }

    .p404-redirect-adminbar-weekly-title {
        font-weight: bold;
        font-size: 14px;
        color: #fff;
        margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button .ab-icon:before {
        content: "\f103";
        color: #dc3545;
        top: 3px;
    }
    
    #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button .ab-item {
        min-width: 80px !important;
        padding: 0px !important;
    }
    
    /* Ensure proper positioning and z-index for P404 dropdown */
    .p404-redirect-adminbar-dropdown-wrap { 
        min-width: 0; 
        padding: 0;
        position: static !important;
    }
    
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button_dropdown {
        position: static !important;
    }
    
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button_dropdown .ab-item {
        padding: 0 !important;
        margin: 0 !important;
    }
    
    .p404-redirect-dropdown-container {
        min-width: 340px;
        padding: 18px 18px 12px 18px;
        background: #23282d !important;
        color: #fff;
        border-radius: 12px;
        box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
        margin-top: 10px;
        position: relative !important;
        z-index: 999999 !important;
        display: block !important;
        border: 1px solid #444;
    }
    
    /* Ensure P404 dropdown appears on hover */
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button .p404-redirect-dropdown-container { 
        display: none !important;
    }
    
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button:hover .p404-redirect-dropdown-container { 
        display: block !important;
    }
    
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button:hover #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button_dropdown .p404-redirect-dropdown-container {
        display: block !important;
    }
    
    .p404-redirect-card {
        background: #2c3338;
        border-radius: 8px;
        padding: 18px 18px 12px 18px;
        box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.07);
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: flex-start;
        border: 1px solid #444;
    }
    
    .p404-redirect-btn {
        display: inline-block;
        background: #dc3545;
        color: #fff !important;
        font-weight: bold;
        padding: 5px 22px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        text-decoration: none;
        font-size: 17px;
        transition: background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
        margin-top: 8px;
        box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(220,53,69,0.15);
        text-align: center;
        line-height: 1.6;
    }
    
    .p404-redirect-btn:hover {
        background: #c82333;
        color: #fff !important;
        box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(220,53,69,0.25);
    }
    
    /* Prevent conflicts with other admin bar dropdowns */
    #wpadminbar .ab-top-menu > li:hover > .ab-item,
    #wpadminbar .ab-top-menu > li.hover > .ab-item {
        z-index: auto;
    }
    
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button:hover > .ab-item {
        z-index: 999998 !important;
    }

← All Events	</a></p><h1 class="tribe-events-single-event-title">Workshop: Clowning Techniques for Actors</h1></div><div id="post-222339" class="post-222339 tribe_events type-tribe_events status-publish hentry tribe_events_cat-social cat_social"><h5 class="wp-block-heading">with Julie Joubert</h5><div  class="tribe-events-schedule tribe-clearfix" ><p class="tribe-events-schedule__datetime">
<span class="tribe-events-schedule__date tribe-events-schedule__date--start">
September 5		</span><span class="tribe-events-schedule__separator tribe-events-schedule__separator--date">
at 			</span>
<span class="tribe-events-schedule__time tribe-events-schedule__time--start">
10:00am			</span>
<span class="tribe-events-schedule__separator tribe-events-schedule__separator--time">
– 				</span>
<span class="tribe-events-schedule__time tribe-events-schedule__time--end">
1:00pm				</span></p></div><blockquote class="wp-block-quote is-layout-flow wp-block-quote-is-layout-flow"><figure class="wp-block-table"><table class="has-fixed-layout"><tbody><tr><td>What can clowning techniques bring to our acting toolbox? <br><br>This workshop devised by Julie Joubert is designed to introduce you to clowning principles. With a series of games based on physical improvisation, we will explore how the clown’s raw authenticity can help us play characters and dynamics that feel genuine to the audience, across comedy and drama.<br><br>The session will include:<br>·       Gentle Feldenkreis physical warm up to soften the body and go beyond our repetitive, habitual ways of moving<br>·       Small-group games to build confidence in physical improvisation<br>·       Opportunities to try out clowning performance in front of the group in a fully safe supportive environment.<br><br>You will learn:<br>·       Tools to help build trust with other performers and to move as part of an ensemble<br>·       How to use the audience’s energy in your own performance<br>·       Playfulness to improve your self-trust during performance.<br><br>While this is a movement-based workshop, the games can be adapted to all levels and abilities. </td></tr></tbody></table></figure></blockquote><div style="height:20px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div><form

/*# sourceURL=global-styles-inline-css */</style><style id="admin-bar-inline-css">/* Hide CanvasJS credits for P404 charts specifically */
    #p404RedirectChart .canvasjs-chart-credit {
        display: none !important;
    }
    
    #p404RedirectChart canvas {
        border-radius: 6px;
    }

    .p404-redirect-adminbar-weekly-title {
        font-weight: bold;
        font-size: 14px;
        color: #fff;
        margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button .ab-icon:before {
        content: "\f103";
        color: #dc3545;
        top: 3px;
    }
    
    #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button .ab-item {
        min-width: 80px !important;
        padding: 0px !important;
    }
    
    /* Ensure proper positioning and z-index for P404 dropdown */
    .p404-redirect-adminbar-dropdown-wrap { 
        min-width: 0; 
        padding: 0;
        position: static !important;
    }
    
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button_dropdown {
        position: static !important;
    }
    
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button_dropdown .ab-item {
        padding: 0 !important;
        margin: 0 !important;
    }
    
    .p404-redirect-dropdown-container {
        min-width: 340px;
        padding: 18px 18px 12px 18px;
        background: #23282d !important;
        color: #fff;
        border-radius: 12px;
        box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
        margin-top: 10px;
        position: relative !important;
        z-index: 999999 !important;
        display: block !important;
        border: 1px solid #444;
    }
    
    /* Ensure P404 dropdown appears on hover */
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button .p404-redirect-dropdown-container { 
        display: none !important;
    }
    
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button:hover .p404-redirect-dropdown-container { 
        display: block !important;
    }
    
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button:hover #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button_dropdown .p404-redirect-dropdown-container {
        display: block !important;
    }
    
    .p404-redirect-card {
        background: #2c3338;
        border-radius: 8px;
        padding: 18px 18px 12px 18px;
        box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.07);
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: flex-start;
        border: 1px solid #444;
    }
    
    .p404-redirect-btn {
        display: inline-block;
        background: #dc3545;
        color: #fff !important;
        font-weight: bold;
        padding: 5px 22px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        text-decoration: none;
        font-size: 17px;
        transition: background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
        margin-top: 8px;
        box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(220,53,69,0.15);
        text-align: center;
        line-height: 1.6;
    }
    
    .p404-redirect-btn:hover {
        background: #c82333;
        color: #fff !important;
        box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(220,53,69,0.25);
    }
    
    /* Prevent conflicts with other admin bar dropdowns */
    #wpadminbar .ab-top-menu > li:hover > .ab-item,
    #wpadminbar .ab-top-menu > li.hover > .ab-item {
        z-index: auto;
    }
    
    #wpadminbar #wp-admin-bar-p404_free_top_button:hover > .ab-item {
        z-index: 999998 !important;
    }
