<img width="596" height="843" src="https://www.towertheatre.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/workshops.jpg" class="rounded mb-3 wp-post-image" alt="" decoding="async" fetchpriority="high" srcset="https://www.towertheatre.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/workshops.jpg 596w, https://www.towertheatre.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/workshops-212x300.jpg 212w" sizes="(max-width: 596px) 100vw, 596px" /></div></header><div class="entry-content"><p class="has-text-align-center wp-block-paragraph"></p><div class="wp-block-columns is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-7387b849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex"><div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow" style="flex-basis:25%"><figure class="wp-block-image size-full"><img decoding="async" width="596" height="843" src="https://www.towertheatre.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/workshops.jpg" alt="" class="wp-image-196361" srcset="https://www.towertheatre.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/workshops.jpg 596w, https://www.towertheatre.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/workshops-212x300.jpg 212w" sizes="(max-width: 596px) 100vw, 596px" /></figure></div><div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow" style="flex-basis:75%"><p class="wp-block-paragraph">Two more in our series of workshops are coming up shortly.</p></div></div><hr class="wp-block-separator has-alpha-channel-opacity"/><p class="wp-block-paragraph">Sunday 4 October – <strong>Producing and Paperwork</strong><br>What happens in the rehearsal room is only one part of bringing a show to the stage. Directing at the Tower also comes with producing responsibilities — and getting those right can make a huge difference to the experience of everyone involved.</p><p class="wp-block-paragraph">This practical workshop will take you through the life of a production, from writing the audition notice to opening night. We’ll cover schedules, company communications, budgets, paperwork, sharing responsibilities with your Stage Manager, and managing a group of people through the whole process — all while still finding time to actually direct your show!</p><p class="wp-block-paragraph">The aim is to help you set yourself up for success before the first rehearsal even begins, stay on top of everything outside the room, and create a well-run, enjoyable production for everyone. You’ll also leave with practical templates and resources to make the job easier.<br><em>Led by Rob Ellis</em></p><div class="wp-block-buttons is-content-justification-center is-layout-flex wp-container-core-buttons-is-layout-3e41869c wp-block-buttons-is-layout-flex"><div class="wp-block-button"><a class="wp-block-button__link has-white-color has-text-color has-background has-link-color wp-element-button" href="https://www.towertheatre.org.uk/event/directors-workshop-producing/" style="border-top-left-radius:12px;border-top-right-radius:12px;border-bottom-left-radius:12px;border-bottom-right-radius:12px;background-color:#bc0b07"><strong>Reserve a Place</strong></a></div></div><table id="tablepress-35" class="tablepress tablepress-id-35"><tbody class="row-striping"><tr class="row-1"><td class="column-1"><img decoding="async" style="width:100px;float:left;margin:0 10px" alt="Rob Ellis" src="https://www.archive.towertheatre.org.uk/archive/2026/biog/rellis.jpg" /><span style="font-size:smaller"><b>Rob Ellis</b> is a freelance theatre producer and fundraiser, originally from Yorkshire, who has been a Tower member for ten years. For the Tower he has directed <em>Brief Encounter, Clybourne Park, The 39 Steps, The Real Inspector Hound, The Chimes</em> and <em>The Merry Wives of Windsor</em> (which toured to Paris). He also recently acted for the first time in a long time, when the Tower toured <em>Shakespeare in Love</em> to Pykard’s Hall in Suffolk. Rob runs Relish Theatre, a LGBTQ+ theatre company, who are Associate Artists at Pleasance Theatre. He was previously Producer at the Actors’ Church in Covent Garden.</span></td></tr></tbody></table><hr class="wp-block-separator has-alpha-channel-opacity"/><p class="wp-block-paragraph">Sunday 15 November – <strong>Warming up and using improvisation in rehearsals</strong><br>This workshop will give you a variety of exercises that can be used as stand-alone warm-ups in themselves and / or to build up readiness for using improvisation in rehearsals.</p><p class="wp-block-paragraph">The exercises we will look at will build up skills and confidence in initiating a scene, agreeing with their scene partner to build up the world of the scene, listening to their scene partner, supporting their scene partner or as an ensemble, and committing to the scene and their character. </p><p class="wp-block-paragraph">We will then work though how to use improvisation in the rehearsal process, looking at creating backstory, helping actors move past their comfort zones to stretch their characters, using attitudes to explore character and relationships, and using improvisation to test a character’s intentions in a scene. <br><em>Led by Jonathan Reed</em></p><div class="wp-block-buttons is-content-justification-center is-layout-flex wp-container-core-buttons-is-layout-3e41869c wp-block-buttons-is-layout-flex"><div class="wp-block-button"><a style="border-top-left-radius:12px;border-top-right-radius:12px;border-bottom-left-radius:12px;border-bottom-right-radius:12px;background-color:#bc0b07"><strong>Reserve a Place</strong></a></div></div><table id="tablepress-34" class="tablepress tablepress-id-34"><tbody class="row-striping row-hover"><tr class="row-1"><td class="column-1"><span style="font-size:smaller"><img decoding="async" style="float:left;margin:0 10px" src="https://www.archive.towertheatre.org.uk/archive/2026/biog/jreed.jpg" alt="Jonathan Reed" width="100" height="125" /><b>Jonathan Reed</b> is an improviser, writer and director. He performed improv across London for over 10 years and was on the writing team for the sketch show <em>Vice Captains</em> (Edinburgh Fringe, 2018) and for a follow up podcast (<em>Vice Captains: How to Life Life</em>, 2021).  He is also part of the Tower Theatre Writer’s Room.  Jon directed <em>Seagulls</em> in 2023, <em>The Children</em> in 2025, and  <em>Jerusalem</em> in 2026 at the Tower, and <em>One Day When We Were Young</em> in 2025 at the Hen and Chickens Theatre.</span></td></tr></tbody></table><hr class="wp-block-separator has-alpha-channel-opacity"/><p><div style="background-color: #bc0b07;border: none;width:100%;margin:auto;color: white;padding: 15px 32px;text-align: center;text-decoration: none;border-radius:13px"> <a style="color:#ffffff" href="https://www.towertheatre.org.uk/social/"><b>Return to details about Social Events</b></a></div></p></div><footer class="entry-footer"><div id="comments" class="comments-area"></div></footer></main></div></div></div></div><footer><div class="bootscore-footer bg-body-tertiary pt-5 pb-3"><div class="container"><div class="row"><div class="col-md-6 col-lg-3"><div class="footer_widget mb-4"><p class="zoom-social-icons-list--align-center"><a href="https://www.towertheatre.org.uk/contact-us/"><b>Contact Us</b></a> </p><ul class="zoom-social-icons-list zoom-social-icons-list--with-canvas zoom-social-icons-list--round zoom-social-icons-list--align-center zoom-social-icons-list--no-labels"><li class="zoom-social_icons-list__item">

                                    <div class="hire__description page-general__description"><p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">Reopened in 2012 in the heart of Piccadilly, Brasserie Zédel is a grand Parisian brasserie with a storied past. The space first opened in 1915 as part of the Regent Palace Hotel, and through the 1990s became the celebrated Atlantic Bar & Grill. Today it brings together several distinct spaces: the Crazy Coqs cabaret bar and lounge, Bar Américain, and the grand Brasserie at its centre.</p>
<p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal">A sought-after setting for premieres and events, Brasserie Zédel has recently hosted parties for Mission Impossible, Bridget Jones, Wicked, Downton Abbey, L’Oréal and the Elle Style Awards. With capacity for up to 500 guests standing and 300 seated, it is an ideal home for larger gatherings in the centre of London’s West End.</p>
</div>

                                        <p>We do not operate a cloakroom at Leicester Square Theatre, however we have partnered with <a href="https://stasher.com/?ref=lsqtheatre&tap_s=4719683-dfc5ea" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><strong>Stasher</strong></a> who offer affordable and secure bag storage in various hotels and shops nearby.                                     >
                                    <span>What time does the box office open?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="what-time-does-the-box-office-open-5" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>Our opening times vary but it’s safe to assume that the Box Office will always be open from 90 minutes before our first performance and will remain open until 30 minutes after the start time of our last performance of the day. Call to check on 020 7734 2222.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>

                                            aria-expanded="false"

                                    <span>Can I book a ticket by phone?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="can-i-book-a-ticket-by-phone-6" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>Yes, you are welcome to give us a call on 020 7734 2222. If your call goes to voicemail then please leave a message and our team will get back to you as soon as they are available.</p>

                                    </div>

                                        <p>If you are unable to locate your order confirmation or link to download your tickets, please contact <a href="mailto:boxoffice@leicestersquaretheatre.com">boxoffice@leicestersquaretheatre.com</a> providing the show name, date and time of the performance and the name on the booking.                                                                                 <div class="section--accordion__item">

                                    <span class="number">1</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#do-you-have-a-cloakroom-1"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-1"
                                    >
                                    <span>Do you have a cloakroom?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="do-you-have-a-cloakroom-1" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>We do not operate a cloakroom at Leicester Square Theatre, however we have partnered with <a href="https://stasher.com/?ref=lsqtheatre&tap_s=4719683-dfc5ea" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><strong>Stasher</strong></a> who offer affordable and secure bag storage in various hotels and shops nearby. Bag storage bookings can be made <a href="https://stasher.com/?ref=lsqtheatre&tap_s=4719683-dfc5ea" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><strong>HERE</strong></a>.</p>
<p> </p>
<p>You are welcome to bring small bags to the theatre, however our security team may ask to search bags on arrival.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">2</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#do-you-accept-cash-2"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-2"
                                    >
                                    <span>Do you accept cash?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="do-you-accept-cash-2" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>No, we no longer accept cash at Leicester Square Theatre. Card and contactless payments are accepted.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">3</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#what-time-do-the-bars-open-3"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-3"
                                    >
                                    <span>What time do the bars open?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="what-time-do-the-bars-open-3" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>There are 4 bars in the venue. The lounge bar is open approximately 1 hour before the show on most nights, the foyer bar, and the 2 bars inside the auditorium open approximately 30 mins before the start time of the show. Our lounge bar often remains open after the show however has a strictly enforced capacity of 50.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">4</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#do-you-offer-a-membership-scheme-4"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-4"
                                    >
                                    <span>Do you offer a membership scheme?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="do-you-offer-a-membership-scheme-4" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p><a href="https://www.leicestersquaretheatre.com/visit-us/priority/">LST Priority</a> is our membership scheme. LST Priority members can take advantage of advance alerts for popular shows, waiting list priority and exclusive member-only ticket offers. Membership is currently priced at £40 per year, paid annually.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">5</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#what-time-does-the-box-office-open-5"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-5"
                                    >
                                    <span>What time does the box office open?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="what-time-does-the-box-office-open-5" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>Our opening times vary but it’s safe to assume that the Box Office will always be open from 90 minutes before our first performance and will remain open until 30 minutes after the start time of our last performance of the day. Call to check on 020 7734 2222.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">6</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#can-i-book-a-ticket-by-phone-6"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-6"
                                    >
                                    <span>Can I book a ticket by phone?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="can-i-book-a-ticket-by-phone-6" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>Yes, you are welcome to give us a call on 020 7734 2222. If your call goes to voicemail then please leave a message and our team will get back to you as soon as they are available.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>If you are unable to locate your order confirmation or link to download your tickets, please contact <a href="mailto:boxoffice@leicestersquaretheatre.com">boxoffice@leicestersquaretheatre.com</a> providing the show name, date and time of the performance and the name on the booking. The box office team are able to resend confirmation emails.</p>

                    <section class="section section--accordion" id="featured-answers">
                        <h4 class="text-lg-left">Featured Answers</h4>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">1</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#do-you-have-a-cloakroom-1"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-1"
                                    >
                                    <span>Do you have a cloakroom?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="do-you-have-a-cloakroom-1" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>We do not operate a cloakroom at Leicester Square Theatre, however we have partnered with <a href="https://stasher.com/?ref=lsqtheatre&tap_s=4719683-dfc5ea" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><strong>Stasher</strong></a> who offer affordable and secure bag storage in various hotels and shops nearby. Bag storage bookings can be made <a href="https://stasher.com/?ref=lsqtheatre&tap_s=4719683-dfc5ea" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><strong>HERE</strong></a>.</p>
<p> </p>
<p>You are welcome to bring small bags to the theatre, however our security team may ask to search bags on arrival.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">2</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#do-you-accept-cash-2"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-2"
                                    >
                                    <span>Do you accept cash?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="do-you-accept-cash-2" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>No, we no longer accept cash at Leicester Square Theatre. Card and contactless payments are accepted.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">3</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#what-time-do-the-bars-open-3"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-3"
                                    >
                                    <span>What time do the bars open?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="what-time-do-the-bars-open-3" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>There are 4 bars in the venue. The lounge bar is open approximately 1 hour before the show on most nights, the foyer bar, and the 2 bars inside the auditorium open approximately 30 mins before the start time of the show. Our lounge bar often remains open after the show however has a strictly enforced capacity of 50.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">4</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#do-you-offer-a-membership-scheme-4"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-4"
                                    >
                                    <span>Do you offer a membership scheme?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="do-you-offer-a-membership-scheme-4" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p><a href="https://www.leicestersquaretheatre.com/visit-us/priority/">LST Priority</a> is our membership scheme. LST Priority members can take advantage of advance alerts for popular shows, waiting list priority and exclusive member-only ticket offers. Membership is currently priced at £40 per year, paid annually.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">5</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#what-time-does-the-box-office-open-5"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-5"
                                    >
                                    <span>What time does the box office open?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="what-time-does-the-box-office-open-5" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>Our opening times vary but it’s safe to assume that the Box Office will always be open from 90 minutes before our first performance and will remain open until 30 minutes after the start time of our last performance of the day. Call to check on 020 7734 2222.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">6</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#can-i-book-a-ticket-by-phone-6"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-6"
                                    >
                                    <span>Can I book a ticket by phone?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="can-i-book-a-ticket-by-phone-6" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>Yes, you are welcome to give us a call on 020 7734 2222. If your call goes to voicemail then please leave a message and our team will get back to you as soon as they are available.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">7</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#i-have-lost-deleted-not-received-my-confirmation-email-and-tickets-7"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-7"
                                    >
                                    <span>I have lost / deleted / not received my confirmation email and tickets?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="i-have-lost-deleted-not-received-my-confirmation-email-and-tickets-7" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>If you are unable to locate your order confirmation or link to download your tickets, please contact <a href="mailto:boxoffice@leicestersquaretheatre.com">boxoffice@leicestersquaretheatre.com</a> providing the show name, date and time of the performance and the name on the booking. The box office team are able to resend confirmation emails.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>

                                    <span>Do you have a cloakroom?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="do-you-have-a-cloakroom-1" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>We do not operate a cloakroom at Leicester Square Theatre, however we have partnered with <a href="https://stasher.com/?ref=lsqtheatre&tap_s=4719683-dfc5ea" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><strong>Stasher</strong></a> who offer affordable and secure bag storage in various hotels and shops nearby. Bag storage bookings can be made <a href="https://stasher.com/?ref=lsqtheatre&tap_s=4719683-dfc5ea" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><strong>HERE</strong></a>.</p>
<p> </p>
<p>You are welcome to bring small bags to the theatre, however our security team may ask to search bags on arrival.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">2</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#do-you-accept-cash-2"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-2"
                                    >
                                    <span>Do you accept cash?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="do-you-accept-cash-2" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>No, we no longer accept cash at Leicester Square Theatre. Card and contactless payments are accepted.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">3</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#what-time-do-the-bars-open-3"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-3"
                                    >
                                    <span>What time do the bars open?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="what-time-do-the-bars-open-3" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>There are 4 bars in the venue. The lounge bar is open approximately 1 hour before the show on most nights, the foyer bar, and the 2 bars inside the auditorium open approximately 30 mins before the start time of the show. Our lounge bar often remains open after the show however has a strictly enforced capacity of 50.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">

                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-4"
                                    >
                                    <span>Do you offer a membership scheme?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="do-you-offer-a-membership-scheme-4" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p><a href="https://www.leicestersquaretheatre.com/visit-us/priority/">LST Priority</a> is our membership scheme. LST Priority members can take advantage of advance alerts for popular shows, waiting list priority and exclusive member-only ticket offers. Membership is currently priced at £40 per year, paid annually.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">5</span>

                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-5"
                                    >
                                    <span>What time does the box office open?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="what-time-does-the-box-office-open-5" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>Our opening times vary but it’s safe to assume that the Box Office will always be open from 90 minutes before our first performance and will remain open until 30 minutes after the start time of our last performance of the day. Call to check on 020 7734 2222.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">

                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-6"
                                    >
                                    <span>Can I book a ticket by phone?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="can-i-book-a-ticket-by-phone-6" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>Yes, you are welcome to give us a call on 020 7734 2222. If your call goes to voicemail then please leave a message and our team will get back to you as soon as they are available.</p>

                                    </div>

                    <section class="section section--accordion" id="featured-answers">

                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">1</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#do-you-have-a-cloakroom-1"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-1"
                                    >
                                    <span>Do you have a cloakroom?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="do-you-have-a-cloakroom-1" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>We do not operate a cloakroom at Leicester Square Theatre, however we have partnered with <a href="https://stasher.com/?ref=lsqtheatre&tap_s=4719683-dfc5ea" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><strong>Stasher</strong></a> who offer affordable and secure bag storage in various hotels and shops nearby. Bag storage bookings can be made <a href="https://stasher.com/?ref=lsqtheatre&tap_s=4719683-dfc5ea" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><strong>HERE</strong></a>.</p>
<p> </p>
<p>You are welcome to bring small bags to the theatre, however our security team may ask to search bags on arrival.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">2</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#do-you-accept-cash-2"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-2"
                                    >
                                    <span>Do you accept cash?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="do-you-accept-cash-2" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>No, we no longer accept cash at Leicester Square Theatre. Card and contactless payments are accepted.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">3</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#what-time-do-the-bars-open-3"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-3"
                                    >
                                    <span>What time do the bars open?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="what-time-do-the-bars-open-3" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>There are 4 bars in the venue. The lounge bar is open approximately 1 hour before the show on most nights, the foyer bar, and the 2 bars inside the auditorium open approximately 30 mins before the start time of the show. Our lounge bar often remains open after the show however has a strictly enforced capacity of 50.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">4</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#do-you-offer-a-membership-scheme-4"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-4"
                                    >
                                    <span>Do you offer a membership scheme?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="do-you-offer-a-membership-scheme-4" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p><a href="https://www.leicestersquaretheatre.com/visit-us/priority/">LST Priority</a> is our membership scheme. LST Priority members can take advantage of advance alerts for popular shows, waiting list priority and exclusive member-only ticket offers. Membership is currently priced at £40 per year, paid annually.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">5</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#what-time-does-the-box-office-open-5"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-5"
                                    >
                                    <span>What time does the box office open?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="what-time-does-the-box-office-open-5" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>Our opening times vary but it’s safe to assume that the Box Office will always be open from 90 minutes before our first performance and will remain open until 30 minutes after the start time of our last performance of the day. Call to check on 020 7734 2222.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">6</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#can-i-book-a-ticket-by-phone-6"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-6"
                                    >
                                    <span>Can I book a ticket by phone?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="can-i-book-a-ticket-by-phone-6" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>Yes, you are welcome to give us a call on 020 7734 2222. If your call goes to voicemail then please leave a message and our team will get back to you as soon as they are available.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">7</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#i-have-lost-deleted-not-received-my-confirmation-email-and-tickets-7"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-7"
                                    >
                                    <span>I have lost / deleted / not received my confirmation email and tickets?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="i-have-lost-deleted-not-received-my-confirmation-email-and-tickets-7" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>If you are unable to locate your order confirmation or link to download your tickets, please contact <a href="mailto:boxoffice@leicestersquaretheatre.com">boxoffice@leicestersquaretheatre.com</a> providing the show name, date and time of the performance and the name on the booking. The box office team are able to resend confirmation emails.</p>

                                    </div>

                                                                                        <p>The smash-hit, internationally acclaimed, award-winning, multi-sell-out phenomenon is back. </p><p>Our cast will present an unconventional, no-holds-barred interpretation of 'Romeo and Juliet', with a tipsily tragic take on William Shakespeare's most iconic roll call of characters: from a rat-arsed Romeo to a juiced-up Juliet, a trollied Tybalt or a mashed-up Mercutio, along with enough booze to sterilise a brewery floor. This will be a tragedy like no other—the cup overfloweth. </p><p>There is no love lost between the Capulet and Montague families, and everyone in Verona knows it. Surely the only hangover cure to centuries of family feuds is two forlorn teenagers from opposite households falling in love with each other? And a swig (or two) of the finest spirits to nudge them in the right direction, of course... What could possibly go wrong? </p><p><b>Warning: Sh!t-faced Shakespeare® may feature foul language, nudity, disembowelled limbs and, occasionally, some Shakespeare.</b></p>

                    <section class="section section--accordion" id="featured-answers">

                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">1</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#do-you-have-a-cloakroom-1"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-1"
                                    >
                                    <span>Do you have a cloakroom?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="do-you-have-a-cloakroom-1" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>We do not operate a cloakroom at Leicester Square Theatre, however we have partnered with <a href="https://stasher.com/?ref=lsqtheatre&tap_s=4719683-dfc5ea" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><strong>Stasher</strong></a> who offer affordable and secure bag storage in various hotels and shops nearby. Bag storage bookings can be made <a href="https://stasher.com/?ref=lsqtheatre&tap_s=4719683-dfc5ea" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><strong>HERE</strong></a>.</p>
<p> </p>
<p>You are welcome to bring small bags to the theatre, however our security team may ask to search bags on arrival.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">2</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#do-you-accept-cash-2"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-2"
                                    >
                                    <span>Do you accept cash?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="do-you-accept-cash-2" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>No, we no longer accept cash at Leicester Square Theatre. Card and contactless payments are accepted.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">3</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#what-time-do-the-bars-open-3"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-3"
                                    >
                                    <span>What time do the bars open?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="what-time-do-the-bars-open-3" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>There are 4 bars in the venue. The lounge bar is open approximately 1 hour before the show on most nights, the foyer bar, and the 2 bars inside the auditorium open approximately 30 mins before the start time of the show. Our lounge bar often remains open after the show however has a strictly enforced capacity of 50.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">4</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#do-you-offer-a-membership-scheme-4"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-4"
                                    >
                                    <span>Do you offer a membership scheme?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="do-you-offer-a-membership-scheme-4" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p><a href="https://www.leicestersquaretheatre.com/visit-us/priority/">LST Priority</a> is our membership scheme. LST Priority members can take advantage of advance alerts for popular shows, waiting list priority and exclusive member-only ticket offers. Membership is currently priced at £40 per year, paid annually.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">5</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#what-time-does-the-box-office-open-5"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-5"
                                    >
                                    <span>What time does the box office open?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="what-time-does-the-box-office-open-5" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>Our opening times vary but it’s safe to assume that the Box Office will always be open from 90 minutes before our first performance and will remain open until 30 minutes after the start time of our last performance of the day. Call to check on 020 7734 2222.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">6</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#can-i-book-a-ticket-by-phone-6"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-6"
                                    >
                                    <span>Can I book a ticket by phone?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="can-i-book-a-ticket-by-phone-6" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>Yes, you are welcome to give us a call on 020 7734 2222. If your call goes to voicemail then please leave a message and our team will get back to you as soon as they are available.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">7</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#i-have-lost-deleted-not-received-my-confirmation-email-and-tickets-7"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-7"
                                    >
                                    <span>I have lost / deleted / not received my confirmation email and tickets?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="i-have-lost-deleted-not-received-my-confirmation-email-and-tickets-7" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>If you are unable to locate your order confirmation or link to download your tickets, please contact <a href="mailto:boxoffice@leicestersquaretheatre.com">boxoffice@leicestersquaretheatre.com</a> providing the show name, date and time of the performance and the name on the booking. The box office team are able to resend confirmation emails.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>

                    <section class="section section--accordion" id="featured-answers">

                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">1</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#do-you-have-a-cloakroom-1"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-1"
                                    >
                                    <span>Do you have a cloakroom?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="do-you-have-a-cloakroom-1" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>We do not operate a cloakroom at Leicester Square Theatre, however we have partnered with <a href="https://stasher.com/?ref=lsqtheatre&tap_s=4719683-dfc5ea" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><strong>Stasher</strong></a> who offer affordable and secure bag storage in various hotels and shops nearby. Bag storage bookings can be made <a href="https://stasher.com/?ref=lsqtheatre&tap_s=4719683-dfc5ea" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><strong>HERE</strong></a>.</p>
<p> </p>
<p>You are welcome to bring small bags to the theatre, however our security team may ask to search bags on arrival.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">2</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#do-you-accept-cash-2"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-2"
                                    >
                                    <span>Do you accept cash?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="do-you-accept-cash-2" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>No, we no longer accept cash at Leicester Square Theatre. Card and contactless payments are accepted.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">3</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#what-time-do-the-bars-open-3"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-3"
                                    >
                                    <span>What time do the bars open?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="what-time-do-the-bars-open-3" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>There are 4 bars in the venue. The lounge bar is open approximately 1 hour before the show on most nights, the foyer bar, and the 2 bars inside the auditorium open approximately 30 mins before the start time of the show. Our lounge bar often remains open after the show however has a strictly enforced capacity of 50.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">4</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#do-you-offer-a-membership-scheme-4"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-4"
                                    >
                                    <span>Do you offer a membership scheme?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="do-you-offer-a-membership-scheme-4" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p><a href="https://www.leicestersquaretheatre.com/visit-us/priority/">LST Priority</a> is our membership scheme. LST Priority members can take advantage of advance alerts for popular shows, waiting list priority and exclusive member-only ticket offers. Membership is currently priced at £40 per year, paid annually.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">5</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#what-time-does-the-box-office-open-5"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-5"
                                    >
                                    <span>What time does the box office open?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="what-time-does-the-box-office-open-5" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>Our opening times vary but it’s safe to assume that the Box Office will always be open from 90 minutes before our first performance and will remain open until 30 minutes after the start time of our last performance of the day. Call to check on 020 7734 2222.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">6</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#can-i-book-a-ticket-by-phone-6"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-6"
                                    >
                                    <span>Can I book a ticket by phone?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="can-i-book-a-ticket-by-phone-6" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>Yes, you are welcome to give us a call on 020 7734 2222. If your call goes to voicemail then please leave a message and our team will get back to you as soon as they are available.</p>

                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                                                                                <div class="section--accordion__item">
                                <div class="section--accordion__item__header">
                                    <span class="number">7</span>
                                    <a
                                            href="#i-have-lost-deleted-not-received-my-confirmation-email-and-tickets-7"
                                            data-toggle="collapse"
                                            role="button"
                                            aria-expanded="false"
                                            aria-controls="accordion-7"
                                    >
                                    <span>I have lost / deleted / not received my confirmation email and tickets?</span>
                                    </a>
                                </div>
                                <div class="collapse" id="i-have-lost-deleted-not-received-my-confirmation-email-and-tickets-7" data-parent="#featured-answers">
                                    <div class="section--accordion__item__content">
                                        <p>If you are unable to locate your order confirmation or link to download your tickets, please contact <a href="mailto:boxoffice@leicestersquaretheatre.com">boxoffice@leicestersquaretheatre.com</a> providing the show name, date and time of the performance and the name on the booking. The box office team are able to resend confirmation emails.</p>

                                    </div>

records.title: Ron Funches
records.description:
Ron Funches is the human embodiment of a warm hug that somehow learned to roast you…with love. 

A master of joyful, disarming stand-up! He has released multiple acclaimed comedy specials. He is a fan-favorite on many TV series including Peacock’s THE TRAITORS, Apple TV’s LOOT, FOX’s NEW GIRL and so much more. 

Ron has a prolific voice-acting career. His voice can be heard in Pixar’s INSIDE OUT 2, DreamWorks TROLLS franchise and HARLEY QUINN just to name a few. 

With his numerous Late-Night appearances, writing credits and overall podcast guest greatness, you’ve got a performer whose superpower is turning warmth, weirdness and razor-sharp jokes into pure delight

records.title: Sh!t-faced Shakespeare®: Romeo and Juliet
records.description:
The smash-hit, internationally acclaimed, award-winning, multi-sell-out phenomenon is back. 

Our cast will present an unconventional, no-holds-barred interpretation of 'Romeo and Juliet', with a tipsily tragic take on William Shakespeare's most iconic roll call of characters: from a rat-arsed Romeo to a juiced-up Juliet, a trollied Tybalt or a mashed-up Mercutio, along with enough booze to sterilise a brewery floor. This will be a tragedy like no other—the cup overfloweth. 

There is no love lost between the Capulet and Montague families, and everyone in Verona knows it. Surely the only hangover cure to centuries of family feuds is two forlorn teenagers from opposite households falling in love with each other? And a swig (or two) of the finest spirits to nudge them in the right direction, of course... What could possibly go wrong? 

Warning: Sh!t-faced Shakespeare® may feature foul language, nudity, disembowelled limbs and, occasionally, some Shakespeare.

records.title: The Horne Section Podcast: Live
records.description:
Raucous, ridiculous, and surprisingly satisfying - The Horne Section Podcast is live at Leicester Square Theatre!

Your evening dose of musical nonsense and anarchic chat will be hosted by Alex Horne and his band. They’ll be joined in the theatre by a very special guest, for some mayhem and plenty of laughs.

It’s a new show every night!

OM Yoga Show

16 - 18 OCT 2026

Door Opening Times

The Great Hall

The OM Yoga Show is one of Europe’s largest yoga events, offering the perfect introduction to the ancient practice of yoga.

With over 200 live classes run by renowned instructors and expert speakers there is something for everyone, including Sound Healing, Traditional Yoga, Pilates, Hot Yoga, Cacao Ceremonies, Meditation, Face Yoga, Gong Baths and much, much more.

New for 2026 is the FÔLD Reformer Pilates Area with FREE classes running over the weekend.

Whether you’re a seasoned yogi or just starting your journey, this event is for everyone! Discover the latest yoga trends, shop for unique yoga gear, and connect with like-minded individuals. Don’t miss out on this amazing opportunity to find your inner peace and rejuvenate your mind, body, and soul.

Your entrance ticket to the OM Yoga Show also includes entry to Mind Body Soul Experience and Vegan Life Live which take place in the same venue over the weekend.

Children under 16 can enter for free when accompanied with an adult. For more information, visit omyogashow.com.

FAQS

Is there a cloakroom?

Yes. Charges apply.

Is photography allowed at the event?

Yes. Professional photography is strictly subject to prior acceptance by Prime Impact contact: [email protected]

Is there an age restriction?

Children under 16 are free but must be accompanied by a paying adult.

Is there a shuttle service?

A free shuttle bus service will be running from Wood green Tube Station & Alexandra Palace Train Station to Alexandra Palace on all open days. The shuttles will start 30 minutes prior to show open and finish 30 minutes after the show closes.

Do I need to bring anything to participate?

You will need to bring along your own yoga mat to participate in some of the Experience Zone sessions.

Do you offer complimentary tickets for PA/essential companion?

Yes. Registered carers are not required to purchase a ticket. They will need to identify themselves as the ticket holders carer and must arrive with the ticket holder.

<p class="x_p1"><span class="x_s1" data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody"><em>Eigengrau</em> /</span><span class="x_s2"> [ay-gen-gr-ow ] – noun. intrinsic light; the colour seen by the eye in perfect darkness</span></p>
<p class="x_p1"><span class="x_s2">Rose believes in true love and leprechauns. Her flatmate Cassie is engaged in a fervent struggle against patriarchal oppression. Across London, Mark believes in the power of marketing. His flatmate Tim Muffin is engaged in a struggle against life.</span></p>
<p class="x_p1"><span class="x_s2">In a city where Gumtree feels like your closest friend, looking for the right person can lead you all the wrong places. </span></p>
<p class="x_p1"><span class="x_s2">Penelope Skinner’s </span><em><span class="x_s1">Eigengrau</span></em><span class="x_s2"> premiered at the Bush Theatre, London, in March 2010.</span></p>
<p class="x_p1"><span class="x_s2">Mop and Bucket Theatre brought </span><em><span class="x_s1">An Intervention</span></em><span class="x_s2"> to The Space in 2025 & 2026 to rave reviews, and now bring <em>Eigengrau</em> as the exciting debut for director Eddie Boyce.</span></p>
<p class="x_p1"><span class="x_s2">Neila Stephens and Tom Zachar will be returning in Eigengrau, alongside the brilliant Hannah Noël Brennan and Joe Urquhart. </span></p>
</div>

<p class="x_p1"><span class="x_s1" data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody"><em>Eigengrau</em> /</span><span class="x_s2"> [ay-gen-gr-ow ] – noun. intrinsic light; the colour seen by the eye in perfect darkness</span></p>
<p class="x_p1"><span class="x_s2">Rose believes in true love and leprechauns. Her flatmate Cassie is engaged in a fervent struggle against patriarchal oppression. Across London, Mark believes in the power of marketing. His flatmate Tim Muffin is engaged in a struggle against life.</span></p>
<p class="x_p1"><span class="x_s2">In a city where Gumtree feels like your closest friend, looking for the right person can lead you all the wrong places. </span></p>
<p class="x_p1"><span class="x_s2">Penelope Skinner’s </span><em><span class="x_s1">Eigengrau</span></em><span class="x_s2"> premiered at the Bush Theatre, London, in March 2010.</span></p>
<p class="x_p1"><span class="x_s2">Mop and Bucket Theatre brought </span><em><span class="x_s1">An Intervention</span></em><span class="x_s2"> to The Space in 2025 & 2026 to rave reviews, and now bring <em>Eigengrau</em> as the exciting debut for director Eddie Boyce.</span></p>
<p class="x_p1"><span class="x_s2">Neila Stephens and Tom Zachar will be returning in Eigengrau, alongside the brilliant Hannah Noël Brennan and Joe Urquhart. </span></p>
</div>

                <div></div>
<div>
<div><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">Pagemaster’s biggest fair of the year! Two full days of zines, workshops and independent publishing highlights at the South London Gallery, running Saturday 29 and Sunday 30 August. </span>Don’t miss this chance to browse this much DIY published zines in one place, meet the makers and explore all the different works from small presses and independent makers, all in one room. Expect a hands on, sociable atmosphere: browsing tables at your own pace, chatting directly with makers about their process, and discovering names you won’t have come across before. On Saturday we’re running our Publishing Practices Workshop for zine makers of all levels, guest hosted by Ioana Simion of Artizine (ticketed separately, space is limited). Come for an hour or stay the whole weekend, there’s something for everyone.</div>
